sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A martial artist and the oldest twin in a family of heroes. Towards the end of her adventures, Purum and her family were dragged into the evil plans of a certain demon. Its power was unlike anything they had ever seen, and it drew them all helplessly into a corner. With no regard for herself, Purum was prepared to risk her own life to protect her family from a fatal blow by the demon. However, the situation only got worse from there, their only saving grace being her younger brother's use of an emergency teleporting spell to carry them to safety.

Towards the end of her adventures, Purum and her family were dragged into the evil plans of a certain demon. Its power was unlike anything they had ever seen, and it drew them all helplessly into a corner. With no regard for herself, Purum was prepared to risk her own life to protect her family from a fatal blow by the demon.
